comment: Every example in README.md, as a runnable case. internal/dagreach/examples_test.go
runs each one and checks the exit code and the lines the documentation quotes,
so an example cannot rot into a lie without failing CI.

examples.name: production-database
examples.outcome: Stop an infrastructure change from reaching a production database
contains: edges: terraform profile, source depends on target

examples.name: new-route-to-production
examples.outcome: Catch a pull request that opens a new route to production

examples.name: vulnerable-package
examples.outcome: Find what a vulnerable package reaches, across ecosystems
contains: edges: cyclonedx profile, source depends on target

examples.name: changed-source
examples.outcome: Know which models, tests and dashboards a changed source reaches
contains: edges: dbt profile, source feeds target
groups touched: model 3, test 2, source 1, exposure 2

examples.name: release-shape
examples.outcome: See what the shape of a plan allows before committing to a date
contains: critical path: 60 of duration over 4 edge(s)

examples.name: slipped-task
examples.outcome: Know what a slipped task delays, and by how much
contains: cost of the impacted set: 58 of declared duration
critical path within the impacted set: 46 of duration over 2 edge(s)

examples.name: materialized-table
examples.outcome: Gate on an attribute the producer emits and dagreach never named
contains: FAIL fail-if-reaches attr:materialized=table: 2 node(s) matching attr:materialized=table are reached

examples.outcome: Refuse to call a question answered when the graph cannot answer it
contains: UNKNOWN fail-if-reaches attr:severity=critical: no node in this graph declares 'severity'
